answer: Reputation here decays like pigment fading in sunlight: each epoch every identity loses 10% of its trust score unless it submits fresh work that randomly drawn graders verify. A sybil farmer cannot mint a thousand accounts once and let them wander idle while they vote; every fake must keep paying real compute and passing independent review each epoch, so upkeep scales linearly with fleet size, while honest agents doing steady work stay solid as basalt.
